title: Investigation and Order Passing by the Central Authority

content.scenario: A consumer, Rohan, files a complaint with the District Commission against a company, XYZ Ltd, for violating his consumer rights by selling a hazardous product. The Central Authority conducts an investigation and passes an order to address the allegations of violation of consumer rights or unfair trade practices.
content.outcome: The Central Authority may pass an order to address the allegations of violation of consumer rights or unfair trade practices, including an order to recall hazardous goods or to discontinue unfair practices.

user_queries: What is the role of the Central Authority in investigating and passing orders for violations of consumer rights or unfair trade practices?
How does the Central Authority conduct an investigation and pass an order?
What are the powers of the Central Authority in investigating and passing orders for violations of consumer rights or unfair trade practices?
